🎃 Welcome to Lag's  Wall Hop Difficulty Chart! 🎃

This is a challenging Wall Hop Difficulty Chart with 90+ Stages!

⭐ Like and favorite the game to counteract the rage quitters! 🔥

📈 Your progress saves, so you can take a break and come back later if you’re stuck!
💀 Press R to Reset!
